records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

We know getting started can slip. If you want a hand setting up your first project or inviting your team, just reply -- happy to help.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Works set up
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Glad to have Quartz Works on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Works* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no first project and no key milestone despite two outreach emails (email:fc8130b2, email:625a31b9) with zero customer reply and no tickets. One invite sent shows some intent, but silence plus no project after a week suggests low unaided odds in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Quartz Works project
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Following up on my note from last week. I noticed an invite has gone out to a teammate already, which is a good start.

The piece that usually makes everything else click is one real project with your actual tasks in it. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that first one sets the shape for the rest.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you, or to answer anything over email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
